news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price gain to ₹2.61, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 23.8x. Average trailing P/E is 18x in the Food industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 65% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.01 (vs ₹0.006 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.01 (up from ₹0.006 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹358.6m (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.82m (up 34% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.5% (up from 0.4% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 9% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 36% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.5x net interest cover). news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.11 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (down from ₹0.11 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹457.4m (up 51% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹11.8m (down 9.4% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.6% (down from 4.3% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 8% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 38% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
